summary: Fixed automatic update-window placement on multi-monitor desktops and simplified the actions shown for mandatory updates.
changelog: Waits for the main window to be fully mapped before creating the automatic update notice opened during launcher startup.
Creates the update notice with its transient parent already assigned, matching the correctly centered manual-check behavior.
Stops changing a visible update window's parent, preventing Wayland from moving it to another monitor or the desktop origin.
Recreates a standalone tray-startup notice when the main window is opened later so it is centered on that window.
Shows only Download New Version and Close Application during mandatory updates; Not Now remains exclusive to optional updates.
